svg.title: E43 does spotting extend the reachable shape region
svg.desc: Six MAP-Elites archives, one per fire, over growth and elongation of the burned area after five days with spotting genes added (SMC_SPOT=1), with E37's own reachable-region boundary (spotting off) overlaid as a dashed line and the observed fire's growth and elongation marked day by day.
svg.text: E43 (spotting on): a knob setting the model can produce
the observed fire, one dot per day
